Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
...Hey! Is that still not done yet?!
……喂！之前的工作还没办完吗？！

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
It's in progress. It will be completed in about three hours.
仍在进行中。预计将在约三小时后完成。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
Hey... Can you do me another favor? Haha, I'll buy you a drink after this.
那个……这次能不能，只再帮我处理一件工作？哈哈，我会买饮料给你的。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
Place it on the third document stack from the right.
请放在右手边第三份文件堆上。

This Fixer Office seems lively at all times.
这个收尾人事务所似乎总是充满活力。

This child's desk in particular was abuzz with voices.
其中，那孩子的座位附近尤其吵闹。

...When you look at it, it also seems like the source of a majority of keyboard taps.
……仔细一看，传遍整个事务所的键盘声似乎大多也都是从这里传来的。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
Hello. This is Meursault from Rosespanner Workshop Office. I have a matter to discuss with you...
您好，这里是玫瑰扳手工坊的默尔索。我想向您咨询一下……

Holding a phone in one hand, he types just as fast with the other.
孩子一手打着电话，敲击键盘的速度却分毫未减。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
Yes, that is right. As always, we would like our newly developed tool to be tested by Tres Association...
啊，是的。与以往一样，我们工坊本次制作的新道具也会交予Tres协会进行审查……

He doesn't forget to make notes with a pen from time to time during all that.
与此同时，他也没有忘记时不时用笔在一旁的纸上做记录。

<Messrs. Tres Association. 1. I am writing to you to inquire about our workshop's item.>
<Tres协会 阁下。1. 平日里十分承蒙关照，衷心表示感谢。>

The child must be taking care of procedures for putting some new gadget developed by the Workshop Office on sale.
那孩子正在做的，应该是为了贩卖工坊事务所开发出的装备而在办理手续吧。

Tres Association, commonly called "the workshop Association", is in charge of evaluating all workshop-made products in the City.
Tres协会……被称为工坊协会的那个协会，负责对都市中的所有工坊制品进行功能审查。

Well, they aren't harsh enough to go after small personal inventions, but... If you want to sell your item, you have to pass their evaluation and have it registered.
不过，也不是每家每户捣鼓出来的机器都需要进行审查……但如果想要贩卖的话，是必须经过审查注册的。

Unauthorized distribution...is forbidden.
未经许可的流通……是禁忌。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.teller:
Imploring Employee
要求众多的员工
dataList.content:
Oh... Are you done with the call? What did they say, did it go well?
哦……你电话打完了？怎么样，进展还顺利吗？

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
Yes, as I am told. It's a simple device, so it's currently under the registration process.
是的。因为是简单的装备，所以现在就能办理注册手续。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.teller:
Imploring Employee
要求众多的员工
dataList.content:
Great! Good job as always, buddy~!
不愧是你！这次也做的很好~！

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
There are documents that need to be filled out for additional approval. From the top of the second document stack...
还有需要以书面形式提交以供二次批准的文件。在第二份文件堆上的……

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.teller:
Imploring Employee
要求众多的员工
dataList.content:
Ahaha... I told you, you're free to do them however you want to.
啊哈哈……我说过的，这些东西全都由你来决定就行。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
...Understood.
……我明白了。

The child wouldn't ever turn down favors others asked of him.
那孩子从未拒绝过请求。

To be precise, he had no reason to.
正确地说，是没有拒绝的理由。

He was the most competent one in this Office, as well as being the quickest to handle work.
因为在这事务所中，他是最有能力，也是工作效率最高的孩子。

The child knew this well...
那孩子也知道这个事实……

And believed that it's natural for him to do the heavy lifting.
因此，自己需要承担工作是理所当然。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
Mm!
嗯！

Though he worked more frequently indoors than outdoors, he was superior in both types of labor.
虽然处理内务比外勤更多，但在外勤方面也能比所有人都优秀的那孩子，

He's been staying in his workplace for weeks now, traveling between the office and work sites without a single trip to home.
已经有好几周都没能回家，只是在事务所与现场不断往返。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
...This is tiring.
……累了。

The child let out a tiny sigh, placing a hand on his temple.
孩子一边揉着眉头，一边轻声叹气。

The monitor showed a line of text that said: <The mail address does not exist.>
屏幕上显示出<邮箱地址不存在。>的文字。

It's true, not every part of the City is interconnected in a network. It's natural that there are some clients that can only be reached with written letters.
嗯，毕竟也不是都市中所有地方都连接了计算机通讯网络。当然也存在只能以书面内容沟通的客户。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
I will...have to write it again. This has put off the estimated time of completion by 2 hours and 17 minutes.
还……需要重写。预定完成时间将会因此延长2小时17分钟。

Murmuring to himself, the child picked up a pen.
孩子一边嘟哝着一边拿起笔。

Normally, a workshop Fixer is like a blacksmith, keeping hammers and steel plates closer than pens or paper.
说到底工坊的收尾人……应该是像铁匠一样，比起笔更喜欢锤子，比起纸更喜欢铁板的收尾人。

But to this child, the line of work seems no different from an ordinary desk job, dealing with...mounds of overdue clerical work.
只有这孩子，积攒了一堆工作……似乎和负责处理业务的公司员工没有区别。

dataList.title:
Rosespanner Workshop
玫瑰扳手工坊
dataList.content:
...Yes, this is Meursault from Rosespanner Workshop Office. Please state your business.
……是，十分感谢您的来电。这里是玫瑰扳手工坊事务所的默尔索。请讲。

Still, perhaps it's thanks to him shouldering most of the desk work that this workshop can operate smoothly.
即使如此，或许也正因为这孩子承担了业务工作，这座工坊才得以运转下去。
